# cDot

> cDot is the blockchain network built for secure, private, and instant payments, designed for
> private payments, verified identity, programmable money and autonomous agents. Built by
> Certonymity Ltd (London, UK).

Rather than forcing everything onto a single chain, cDot is a family of purpose-built blockchains,
each engineered for what it does best: identity, stablecoin settlement, and trading, operating
as one trusted network.

Mission: cDot is where value is exchanged between people, businesses, and machines. It is the
blockchain network built for secure, private, and instant payments between any two verified parties.
Using cryptographic pseudonyms of real verified identities, cDot ensures every transaction is both
private and accountable. It is an alternative to the inefficiencies and privacy costs of traditional
finance, a regulatable framework for private payments, and a purpose-built system for the future of
money.

The problem: stablecoins enable instant, borderless, programmable transactions, but today's
blockchains aren't designed for them. Existing systems are either fully general or optimised for
trading, and none were built to integrate identity with payments. Payments at scale don't just need
speed and low cost - they need verifiable identity on both sides of a transaction. As AI agents
increasingly transact on behalf of people and businesses, stablecoin payments also need native agent
identity to remain accountable, auditable, and trusted. No single general-purpose chain can serve all
these purposes. Combining decentralised identity, stablecoin payments, and agent permissions, cDot
exists to close the gap. cDot is built by the team behind c.Email (https://c.email/).

The network (three chains, interoperable by design):

1. C-Layer - identity and asset recovery chain: a decentralised identity chain for people,
   businesses, and agents. Cryptographic pseudonyms of verified real identities provide privacy with
   accountability. 15,000 tx/s through a highly parallel architecture, WASM smart contracts, 20s
   finality, permissionless, public and pseudonymous, run by nodes around the world for maximum
   resilience and decentralisation.
2. P-Layer - settlement chain: engineered for high-throughput, low-cost global stablecoin
   settlement and truly programmable money, with native on- and off-ramping; 30,000 tx/s, finality
   <1s, byzantine security 45%; agentic transactions supported with verifiable, revocable
   permissions.
3. T-Layer - trading chain: a high-performance decentralised exchange, offering stablecoin swaps and
   perpetual futures in a predictable execution environment. 30,000 tx/s through native
   multithreaded operations, finality <1s, a node-permissioned overlay on the C-layer, private and
   accountable, native NASDAQ-like matching engine.

Use cases - instant, low-cost settlement for any use case: global payments and payroll,
remittances, embedded finance, microtransactions, machine-to-machine commerce, on- and off-ramping,
asset recovery (never lose your self custodied crypto), bank accounts. With real-time settlement,
low fees, and no middlemen, stablecoins are as much a way to save money as a cryptocurrency. cDot's
secure design and invisible cryptography means every transaction settles instantly, every
participant (human or agent) is verified and accountable, while every real-world identity and
transaction stays private. Transfer money, pay teams and suppliers, settle trades, and do much more
on cDot.
